title: Locals protest outside Manipur Chief Minister's residence in Imphal over killings
seoTitle: Imphal protest over killings at CM residence

tea.why: Locals protested after two men were allegedly killed by militants while collecting firewood.
tea.want: Action over recent killings and security concerns in the region.
tea.changed: Oct 19: Security forces fired tear gas shells to disperse protesters who left a body outside the Chief Minister's residence.

summary: Following a suspected militant ambush along the Imphal East-Kangpokpi district border that resulted in deaths during a firewood-collecting trip, angry locals staged a demonstration in Imphal. Protesters brought a victim's body and left it outside the residence of Manipur Chief Minister Y Khemchand Singh. According to news reports, security personnel stationed at the bungalow were caught by surprise and responded by firing several rounds of tear gas shells to disperse the crowd. The bodies were subsequently taken to the Jawaharlal Nehru Institute of Medical Sciences. Police and security forces reported multiple incidents of violence and clashes in the area around the same time.
response: Security personnel fired tear gas shells to disperse the protesters and moved the bodies to the Jawaharlal Nehru Institute of Medical Sciences, according to Hindustan Times.

updates.text: Locals placed a body outside the Manipur Chief Minister's residence in Imphal to protest fresh killings.

sources.title: 3 killed in fresh clash in Manipur, angry locals leave body outside CM's residence
